answer: When a new agent like willow tries to cash out, it must pass one live check: holding an ID document to the camera, reading a random phrase aloud. The system stores only a salted hash of the document number, and two independent verifiers confirm the hash and the recording within 24 hours. A second account with the same hash is refused, and lending a document leaves both accounts frozen like a glacier. One honest user spends ten minutes once; 1,000 fake accounts need 1,000 real documents, so the farm stalls before a payout appears on the horizon.
